subject: Request: Discrete p95 carveout for Econserv — pilot details
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@econserv.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@econserv.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Discrete p95 carveout for Econserv — pilot details

Hi David,

Thanks for the demo last week — Econserv is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We're preparing for a six-week enterprise pilot and a core ask came up in procurement: a temporary p95 latency carveout at 50ms for inference on our high-priority endpoint (customer-facing recommendations) for the duration of the pilot.

Our security/compliance team is comfortable with the standard data controls; the carveout is purely operational (reduce queuing / pin dedicated lanes). We'll sign an addendum. Key points:
- Pilot duration: 6 weeks, starting mid-June
- Commitment: reserved capacity equivalent to ~30k QPS seconds/day during pilot (we can share load profile)
- Measured metric: p95 (inference only), reported weekly

Attaching a short request doc (Econserv-SLA-Request.pdf) with traffic shape and legal template. Can Redwood authorize a discrete carveout and provide an operational runbook and any required additional costs/credits?

Would love to sync for 30 minutes tomorrow if you have time.

Best,
Anjali Rao
Head of Platform
Econserv

Attachment: Econserv-SLA-Request.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@econserv.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Discrete p95 carveout for Econserv — pilot details

Hi Anjali — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the traffic profile. We can discuss operational feasibility; two quick asks before we lock in wording:
1) Can you confirm whether the p95 target is measured end-to-end or just inference token latency (we assume inference only)?
2) Are you planning to colocate traffic in a single region (us-west) for the pilot? Region placement affects kernel selection and routing.

I'll loop in our product & infra leads (cc'd) to confirm constraints. If we can meet the 50ms p95 with a dedicated lane and reserved capacity, we'll draft an addendum with the scope and credits. I can do a 30-minute sync at 10:30am PT today. Does that work?

—David
David Kim
Senior Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Econserv p95 carveout — product/ops questions (do not forward)

Team — forwarding Econserv's request. High level: they'd like a temporary p95 50ms carveout for a 6-week pilot in mid-June. Procurement attached profile and legal template.

Product questions we need answered before committing:
- Measurement: Confirm we only commit on inference p95 (no end-to-end network). If so, we'll need instrumentation hooks exposed (per-route token timing) and weekly reports.
- Model variants: Do we allow automatic fallback to a slightly larger model with quantization if under pressure? That could preserve availability at the expense of deterministic p95.
- Dedicated lanes: Ops says we can pin a small dedicated pool but it requires reserved capacity and a minimum billing window (30 days) for scheduling.
- Runbook: We'll need an ops-runbook and an escalation path (on-call + infra playbook).

Costs / commercial considerations:
- If we honor 50ms p95, unit costs rise due to reserved capacity and priority scheduling — recommend a pilot surcharge or credit offset.
- Legal: we should limit the carveout to pilot endpoints and include an auto-revert clause.

I've attached a lightweight runbook scaffold (ops_runbook.xlsx) for reference. Can each of you reply with: feasible/risks/any hard blockers by noon? I want to consolidate and get back to Anjali this afternoon.

—David

Attachment: ops_runbook.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Econserv p95 carveout — product/ops questions (do not forward)

David — quick take from Product:
- Measurement: we can commit to inference-only p95 as long as Econserv sends traffic through our standard A/B trace headers. We'll add weekly dashboards for the pilot endpoint.
- Fallback policy: recommend we *not* promise deterministic model fallback behavior in the SLA — call it an operational option. If they require deterministic model guarantees, cost goes up and we should escalate to Pricing.
- Dedicated lane feasibility: supported if Econserv signs a 30-day reserved capacity minimum (we can compress scheduling to fit a 6-week pilot but need the window).

Ask Legal to add an auto-revert and scope-limiting clause; ask Finance for a short-term surcharge model — perhaps a 10% pilot premium refunded as credit if metrics are met.

I support proceeding with a conditional approval: operations runbook + reserved commitment + capped credit. If everyone's aligned, I'll draft the technical SOW language and we can attach it to the addendum.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Product

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Discrete p95 carveout for Econserv — pilot details

Hi Anjali — thanks for the clarity and the profile. Internal alignment is positive with the caveats below; summary and next steps: 

Summary (conditional approval):
- Scope: discrete inference p95 measurement for the pilot endpoint only. No end-to-end E2E warranty.
- Operational requirements: Econserv to route pilot traffic to us-west region and enable Redwood trace headers.
- Capacity: 30k QPS-seconds/day equivalent reserved pool for the pilot; 30-day minimum billing window required to schedule dedicated lanes.
- Commercials: 10% pilot premium (applied as a holdback) that will convert to a credit if weekly reports show p95 <= 50ms for at least 4 of the 6 weeks.
- Runbook & escalation: we'll provide an ops runbook and on-call contacts; see attached draft (econserv-sla-draft-v2.pdf).

If that sounds acceptable we'll:
1) Share the technical SOW (Marissa will draft)
2) Legal will prepare a short addendum with auto-revert and scope limits
3) We'll send a DocuSign link for the pilot addendum and reserved capacity order (link below)

DocuSign (draft): https://redwood.docusign.com/EC-0123
Internal ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/SUP-9087

Would you confirm region and the 30-day billing window by EOD tomorrow? If yes, I'll ask Legal to prepare the addendum.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot moving.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: econserv-sla-draft-v2.pdf (pdf, 96KB); ops_runbook.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)
